rule: MTP step = the composed step (token_path_export) + every critical charge; overlapped charges carry their proof

charges.element: WFC kit (ot_rom_pkg_ctrl_wfc SOURCE/STG + dsfd_wfc_lnk + dsfd_wfc_vmx) on every stage hop
charges.formula: 120 stage hops (AR view critical path: substage/head hops + the unplaced stage hops) x 113 (WFC done->out + entry delta 13 + lnk 6 + vmx start 15 + vmx done/prefetch 79)
charges.variant: WFC HARD kit (STG CLOSED, HARD wfc_tok CLOSED, SOURCE partner routing); --wfc-hard is default-off on the die
charges.note: the composition charges the reference ot_rom_pkg_ctrl_wf (46/11,271 handoff, no shims) whose route was rejected; the real controller kit adds these on the verify AR pass. Same cycles on every AR token once the kit is default-on (ar_effect).

charges.element: WFC kit on the 5 wavefront intervals (positions 2-6)
charges.formula: 5 x (hop 113 + handoff 49 vs 46 on the busiest stage 8.6 + stage occupancy 94)
charges.note: upper bound charged: the vmx start/done cycles are counted both in the hop latency and as stage occupancy (no bench measures the handoff with vmx in place, so the overlap of the outbound prefetch with the next position's start is NOT proven); cycles_lower counts them once (608)

charges.element: dsfd_mtp_seq draft chain (seed rows -> first draft head, head result -> next head)
charges.note: bench means include the bench adapters (+2 in / +1 out): upper bound; each draft head step waits for the previous head's argmax (serial chain)

charges.element: dsfd_mtp_seq seed after the closing result + DRAFT flit / release
charges.formula: seed_after_close 8 + last_dh_to_draft_flit 14.4 (s0_hash_u1_fast: no squashed results to wait for)
charges.note: the other traces' release (51.6-231 cycles) includes waiting for squashed verify results the bench models serially; those positions are already charged as verify intervals

charges.element: dsfd_wfc_tok HARD (S0 token/draft store, one-edge read)

charges.formula: commit outputs registered 1 cycle after acc_done

charges.element: MD-2 P2 selected path (PRIMARY_SHARED1 9-SRAM transport + 3-SRAM A-prefix + publisher)
source: physical/mtp_p2_transport/route.sh header (codex/mtp-die-continuation 0091c7ad5 gate PASS 5,467 cycles; reproduced by mtp-lead for mtp-p2-path-{a,b}-91473d972-tc)
~/claude-takeover-20261007/REVIEW_20261009.md V22 (5,467 cycles per rank prefix, <= 6,240 model)
charges.variant: selected P2 path (routes queued, not closed); the composition's draft is the DP1-EP5 recovery placement
charges.note: per draft block the rank prefix replaces only the expert return hop; the block's combine all-reduce stays (no record replaces it): upper bound. Blocks are serial (block k+1 consumes block k's hc_post), so critical.

charges.formula: 5 draft steps x (first result 178 cycles - modelled 65.5)
charges.note: lower bound: the measured single-row pipeline latency is a floor the transfer-ratio model is under; the whole-vocab sweep throughput needs the head full340_A production wrapper (not built)

sensitivity_not_credited.why_not_credited: dsfd_mtp_seq starts the draft at the closing result while positions a+1..5 are still in verify; the draft head steps then share the head die's lm_head bundle with the verify positions' head passes. The bench proves the sequencing, not a conflict-free head schedule: overlap NOT proven, so not credited

ar_effect.rule: the WFC kit's per-hop cycles on the AR pass; apply to the AR views when --wfc-hard is default-on
